notes.title: The Entity Update 0.1
notes.notes:
Update 0.1
The Entity Update

It’s finally here after the long waits and many bug fixes. The Entity Update is live and now you can test it out for yourself as we grow the game to its full glory and potential. The Demo Update is around the corner.

ADDITIONS
• Added Level 1 + corresponding variations 
• Added Inventory System
• Added Items Almond Water, Flashlight, Pills
• Added new entity: The REDACTED
• Added menu music 

ADJUSTMENTS
• Adjusted brightness for Flashlight 
• Adjusted Level 0 wall placement 
• Adjusted player height and collision radius 
• Adjusted film grain 

FIXES
• Fixed enemy AI being able to see through walls 
• Fixed enemy AI being able to track you down through any means 
• Fixed player controller bugs
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
